hypothesis: For contiguous 2-D RMSNorm on sm_120, keeping each row in one 256-thread block and accumulating the sum of squares in registers followed by warp-shuffle reduction should reduce synchronization and shared-memory traffic versus a block-wide reduction.
techniques: single shared-memory staging step for warp totals
expected_effect: modest latency improvement for medium and large hidden sizes while preserving fp16, bf16, and fp32 output dtype
